subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: If the author of a diff touching a protected path cannot be determined in CI, then the attribution gate shall fail closed for that protected-path subset (treat an underivable author touching a protected path as a refusal).
rationale: ambiguity must not fail open on the policy surface (AP-17)
fit_criterion: an attribution-underivable fixture touching a protected path is refused; a determinable human-authored one is not
